blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five refreshed views and six poses. The raised leg-panel hems now read as separate upper/mid-thigh shorts in neutral and standing views. Crouch still shows a bright triangular discontinuity and exposed body at the inner thigh; sit shows a large pale sheet between the thighs and exposed surfaces. Coverage and appearance remain rejected; fit, opacity, strain and Shape Key behavior are unapproved.

Directly inspected all five refreshed views and six poses. The standing skirt remains a broad A-line with irregular folds rather than clearly ordered pleats. Crouch, sit and prone show large angular rear/between-leg sheets and curled or collapsed hem sections. No appearance or cloth-motion acceptance.

Directly inspected all five refreshed views and six poses. Sleeve and underarm transitions remain visibly faceted and wrinkled in neutral, raised-arm and crossed-arm views; the collar still reads as a tall open cylindrical rim. The diagonal lilac closure reads as a broad strip, while narrow edging and rear waist tab remain hard to distinguish. Surface, neckline, measured fit, strain, clearance and runtime remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
